pass_conditions: visual PDF review has zero blocking defects
downgrade_path: watchlist only / insufficient evidence, CONDITIONAL, or MECHANICAL_PASS_INSTITUTIONAL_FAIL if restructuring, order conversion, normalized earnings, or original Street coverage remains incomplete

pre_publish_self_checklist.evidence_depth: official filings, restructuring documents, company-scoped order disclosures, industry cycle evidence and original broker sources are archived and source-tiered
pre_publish_self_checklist.full_chain_depth: full-chain universe, taxonomy, core-vs-satellite classification, competition, relationships, customer audit, company cards, economics, coverage gaps and earnings bridge are reviewed; exactly one valuation parent is 600150.SH and method-specific blockers are explicit
pre_publish_self_checklist.broker_consensus_depth: each Street row preserves broker/date/rating/target/forecast/method/source quality; weak rows have zero weight
pre_publish_self_checklist.model_depth: actual and pro-forma perimeter, backlog, price, mix, delivery, recognition, margin, EPS, cash-flow and working-capital bridges are explicit
pre_publish_self_checklist.valuation_depth: cycle-adjusted valuation plus enterprise-value, asset or SOTP sanity check, three scenarios, market-implied anchor and reproducibility audit
pre_publish_self_checklist.secondary_market_depth: adjustment-labelled continuous daily K-line, dated turnover/circulating-share snapshot, margin, Shanghai Connect, fund holdings and Dragon-Tiger lookback are source-backed; unresolved strict-free-float or daily-Connect fields have an archived boundary
pre_publish_self_checklist.ic_readiness: action, price discipline, catalysts, invalidation, next-result thresholds, restructuring and execution risks, and monitoring plan are explicit
